notes.albums: Seven albums: retro (9), half zip (4), hoodie (1), training set (2), player version (14), kids set (3), fan version (11). One photograph per garment throughout - nothing to group.
notes.dedupe: Only four Manchester City products were live before this batch and dedupe-0905.py matched none of them. Two matched by eye: the 2025/26 home and the 2025/26 away, both filed against their fan photograph, with the player-album shirts of the same kits created as Player Versions.
notes.notADuplicate: The live 2026/27 Goalkeeper Jersey is BRIGHT TEAL with a honeycomb print. The green keeper shirts here (p356, p369) are dark forest green with a different print - a different kit, listed as new.
notes.playerAlbumRetro: p362 is the 2013/14 Nike home shirt but the client sent it inside the player-version album, so it is priced at the player tier and titled Player Version. The same kit also appears in the retro album as p342 at the retro tier - that is the client's own split, not an error.
notes.seasonReading: Sponsor pins the era: Brother to 1999, EIDOS 1999-2002, Thomas Cook 2007-2009, Etihad Airways 2009 onward; Kappa to 2003, Umbro 2009-2013, Nike 2013-2019, Puma 2019 onward. The Asahi training wear, the goalkeeper shirts and the special-edition prints cannot be dated from the garment, so those titles carry a colour and are marked seasonConfidence unknown.
